title: get_events input
description: List events. With no from/to, returns upcoming events in start order.

from.description: Only events ending at or after this time (default: now).

to.description: Only events starting before this time.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 20). Servers MAY return fewer.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token. Absent or null when there are no more results.
